answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 5331 Country: India Title: During umrah at Mecca, does one have to tonsure himself, or can cutting your hair without a completely tonsuring your head also do? Question: During umrah at Mecca, does one have to tonsure himself, or can cutting your hair without a completely tonsuring your head also do? Answer ID: 5331 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1065/801=H-1429) It is better to do halaq (shaving head) in any case. If hair is so long that may be cut equal to a tip of finger, then qasr (trimming hair) is also allowable, but if hair is shorter than that, then qasr is not allowed only halaq is necessary. And if one does umrah again and again, halaq has to be done every time, no matter if there is no hair on head i.e. in this case, it is mandatory to pass on blade all around head like doing halaq , otherwise he will not be Halal (one can not put off ihram ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
